title: Porto Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Porto Cathedral medium-fi exterior: granite fortress twin towers with domed caps/corner pinnacles, large west rose and layered portal, crenellated buttressed nave/transepts and red-tiled choir. North baroque loggia has open round arcades/blue-white tile abstractions. Immediate mapped Gothic cloister/Casa do Cabido ranges retain open courtyard and pointed arcade rhythm. Shared surfaces and four browser LODs. Separate bishop palace, exact narrative azulejos/sculpture, full interiors and surveyed terrace/stair engineering excluded.
